summary:
The fixed sky. Two different kinds of number live here and the distinction is the point of this file.

(1) RULINGS - the frozen clock, the no-weather ruling and the no-clouds ruling. D16 froze time of day and removed all weather for reproducibility; D98 zeroed the four cloud weights and the cloud shadow off the owner's no-clouds ruling; D99 kept 12:00 UTC and REFUSED the owner's literal 14:00, shipping Aug2017KotkClear1400 as a named one-restart A/B instead of asserting the answer. D97 records that Z1's sky block is not re-adopted - D18 already ported it in full and D30's supersession stands.

(2) CLIENT TRANSCRIPTION - the 33 sky floats of SkySettings.Default. Those are the sky_Z*.xml author's own 12:00 row, hand-copied into C# by the docs/30 lane. They are the CLIENT's numbers, so they are NOT rulings and get no constant here; S8 defect T7 already records that a re-extraction cannot detect drift in them, and closing that is a 2B/2A generator job (derive the preset from out/lighting-research), not a rulings job.

rows.note: Z1's 14:00 is explicitly NOT adopted. The argument carries an open UNCERTAIN (docs/50 s3.2), which is why Aug2017KotkClear1400 exists rather than an assertion.

rows.source: docs/38 - there is never any weather: no clouds, no rain, no fog
the client's own sky_Z*.xml 12:00 row plus FUN_140a7c6d0, transcribed by hand into src/Cranberry.Zone/Environment/SkySettings.cs (D30)
rows.note: NOT A RULING and deliberately NOT given a constant here. Fog density 1.0e-4, fog floor 1, fog gradient 0.05, temperature 75, sun axis (38, -15), wind (-0.6, 0.4) at 2.099, the cumulus/stratus tiling, scroll, height and animation block, sky clarity 0.25, silver lining 20.5 / 20 - all of them are the sky_Z author's, i.e. the client's. S8 defect T7: a re-extraction cannot detect drift in a hand transcription, and the cure is a generator over out/lighting-research (lane 2A/2B), not a ruling row. Aug2017KotkClear overrides exactly five of them (the rows above) and nothing else.

rows.source: src/Cranberry.Zone/Environment/EnvironmentPresets.cs:181-213 - the vibrancy knob; the 50/75/100 variants are named presets, not defaults
rows.note: UNRULED as a number. D41 rules that the remaining dullness is a CLIENT-SIDE setting and that no new preset ships as the fix, so the Vivid ladder exists only as a named A/B. Left as a literal: it is written as WithSkyClarity(...) calls rather than as a field default (docs/101 s5).
